patches.new:
- *Neologisms*: invented words
  - *Clang associations*: words strung together by sound rather than meaning ("store, floor, door, more")
  - *Perseveration*: returning repeatedly to the same word or idea regardless of the question asked

visual.title: Pathways, symptom classes and the duration ruler
visual.alt: Four stacked cards for the mesolimbic, mesocortical, nigrostriatal and tuberoinfundibular dopamine pathways, each giving its route, its state in schizophrenia and what D2 blockade does to it; two panels contrasting positive symptoms with the five A negative symptoms; and a timeline from one day to beyond six months marking brief psychotic disorder, schizophreniform disorder and schizophrenia, with delusional disorder and schizoaffective disorder listed separately.
visual.caption: A D2 blocker cannot aim. The same blockade that quiets the mesolimbic pathway hits the other three, which is where the side effects come from.
